$comment: MCP tools of the AerBIM Manager Revit add-in. Each name must match a command registered in Mcp/McpCommandExecutor.cs. inputSchema is JSON Schema; defaults are applied by the server before the call.

tools.name: ping
tools.title: Check Revit connection
tools.description: Checks that the AerBIM Manager add-in in Revit is reachable. Returns Revit version, the active document, the shared parameter file selected in Revit and the list of available commands.

tools.name: list_project_parameters
tools.title: List project parameters
tools.description: Lists project parameters of the active Revit project (Manage > Project Parameters): id, name, kind (shared/project), GUID, binding (instance/type), properties-palette group and bound categories.

nameContains.description: Return only parameters whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).

tools.name: remove_project_parameter
tools.title: Remove a project parameter
tools.description: Removes a project parameter from the active Revit project by id or exact name. All values of this parameter in all elements are lost, and dependent elements may be removed. dryRun defaults to true: it only reports what would be deleted. Show the preview to the user and get explicit confirmation before calling again with dryRun=false.

name.description: Exact parameter name. If several parameters share it, use id.

dryRun.description: true = preview only (default); false = actually delete.

tools.name: read_shared_parameter_file
tools.title: Read shared parameter file (ФОП)
tools.description: Reads a Revit shared parameter file (ФОП): groups and parameters with name, GUID, data type and description. Without filePath reads the file currently selected in Revit. Revit's own setting is restored afterwards.

filePath.description: Full path to the shared parameter .txt file. Omit to use the file selected in Revit.

nameContains.description: Return only parameters whose name contains this text.

group.description: Return only parameters of this group of the file.

tools.name: list_bindable_categories
tools.title: List bindable categories
tools.description: Lists categories of the active project that project parameters can be bound to: localized name, BuiltInCategory (OST_*) and category type. Use these names or OST_ ids in add_shared_parameters.

nameContains.description: Return only categories whose name contains this text.

tools.name: list_parameter_groups
tools.title: List parameter groups
tools.description: Lists properties-palette groups (e.g. data, text, identity_data, constraints) with localized labels. Use key, label or typeId as parameterGroup in add_shared_parameters.

tools.name: add_shared_parameters
tools.title: Add shared parameters from ФОП
tools.description: Adds shared parameters from a shared parameter file (ФОП) to the active document. In a project: binds them to the given categories as instance or type parameters; if a parameter is already bound with the same binding, missing categories are added. Changing instance/type of an existing project parameter is refused because it erases values. In the family editor: adds the parameters to the current family (categories are ignored); allowKindChange switches instance/type of parameters already in the family. dryRun defaults to true: report what would change. Show the preview and get the user's confirmation before calling with dryRun=false. Changes are undoable in Revit (Ctrl+Z).

parameters.description: Parameters from the file: GUID (preferred), exact name, or 'Group/Name' when the name is not unique.

categories.description: Project only: category names as in Revit or BuiltInCategory ids (OST_Walls). See list_bindable_categories.

parameterGroup.description: Properties-palette group: key (data), label or typeId. Default: data. See list_parameter_groups.

filePath.description: Full path to the shared parameter file. Omit to use the file selected in Revit.

allowKindChange.description: Family editor only: switch instance/type of parameters that already exist in the family.

tools.name: list_sheets
tools.title: List sheets
tools.description: Lists sheets of the active project: id, number, name, title block (family : type) and placed views. Optionally returns values of given sheet parameters.

contains.description: Return only sheets whose number or name contains this text.

parameters.description: Sheet parameter names whose values to return (e.g. ADSK_Штамп Раздел проекта).

tools.name: list_title_blocks
tools.title: List title blocks
tools.description: Lists title block types (основные надписи) of the active project: id, family, type and the real sheet size in mm, measured by a temporary placement that is rolled back. Also lists format-related parameters (format, multiplicity, width, height) so you can see whether the format is chosen by type or by instance parameters.

measure.description: Measure sheet sizes (slower on projects with many title blocks).

tools.name: create_sheets
tools.title: Create sheets
tools.description: Creates sheets in the active project with a title block, number, name and sheet parameters. Numbers already used in the project or repeated in the list are skipped before anything is created; each sheet is created atomically, so a failed sheet leaves nothing behind. dryRun defaults to true: report what would be created. Get the user's confirmation before calling with dryRun=false. Undoable in Revit (Ctrl+Z).

titleBlock.description: Title block: id, 'Family : Type', type name if unique, or 'none'. See list_title_blocks.

number.description: Sheet number. Omit for Revit's next number.

parameters.description: Sheet parameter values by name, e.g. {"ADSK_Штамп Раздел проекта": "АР"}. Numbers may include units ("5 м").

tools.name: list_views
tools.title: List views
tools.description: Lists views of the active project (floor plans by default): id, name, type, level, scale, crop state and size, scope box, view template and the sheet the view is placed on.

viewType.description: Revit ViewType: FloorPlan, CeilingPlan, EngineeringPlan, AreaPlan, Section, Elevation, ThreeD, DraftingView, Legend, or all.

nameContains.description: Return only views whose name contains this text.

notOnSheet.description: Return only views not placed on any sheet.

tools.name: crop_view
tools.title: Crop view (Обрезать вид)
tools.description: Sets the crop region of a view (Обрезать вид). Modes: 'model' - bounds of model elements visible in the view (and linked models) plus offset; 'grids' - rectangle through intersections of the given grids plus offset; 'rectangle' - explicit model coordinates in mm; 'scopeBox' - assign a scope box; 'off' - disable cropping. A scope box or non-rectangular crop that blocks the change is removed and reported. Returns the crop size in model mm and on the sheet at the view scale - use it before place_view_on_sheet. dryRun defaults to true.

view.description: View id or exact name. See list_views.

mode.description: How to compute the crop region.

offsetMm.description: Offset around the found bounds, model mm (model, grids, rectangle).

rectangleMm.description: mode=rectangle: [minX, minY, maxX, maxY] in model mm (project internal coordinates).

annotationCropOffsetMm.description: Enable annotation crop with this offset (mm on sheet). Omit to leave unchanged.

tools.name: place_view_on_sheet
tools.title: Place view on sheet with fitting format
tools.description: Places a view (e.g. a floor plan) on a sheet and picks the sheet format to fit it: the viewport size is measured at the view scale, title block types of one family are measured, and the smallest format whose working area (sheet minus frame margins and the stamp band) fits the view is chosen. Places on an existing sheet (its title block type is changed if fitFormat) or creates a new sheet. The view is centred in the working area. If nothing fits, the largest format is used and a scale is suggested. Crop the view first with crop_view. dryRun defaults to true.

view.description: View id or exact name. See list_views.

sheetId.description: Existing sheet id. Omit sheetId/sheetNumber to create a new sheet.

newSheet.description: New sheet: number, name (default: view name), parameters.

titleBlockFamily.description: Title block family whose types are the candidate formats. Required when the project has several title block families and no sheet/titleBlock defines it.

titleBlock.description: Specific title block (id or 'Family : Type'). With fitFormat=false it is used as is.

fitFormat.description: Choose the smallest fitting format (changes the title block type of an existing sheet).

scale.description: Set view scale 1:N before placing (ignored if controlled by a view template).

marginsMm.description: Frame margins in sheet mm. Default GOST 2.301: left 20, top 5, right 5, bottom 5.

stampHeightMm.description: Height of the stamp band kept free at the bottom (GOST 2.104 form 3: 55 mm). 0 = do not reserve.

duplicateIfPlaced.description: If the view is already on a sheet, place a duplicate with detailing.

tools.name: place_on_sheet
tools.title: Place legend, drafting view or schedule on a sheet
tools.description: Places a legend, drafting view, schedule (or any other view) on an existing sheet without changing the sheet format. position=auto finds free space inside the frame working area (right column first, top to bottom), keeping clear of placed views, schedules and the stamp (GOST 2.104 form 3, 185x55 mm at bottom-right). Other positions: top-right, top-left, bottom-right (above the stamp), bottom-left, center, or xy (top-left corner in mm from the sheet's bottom-left corner). Legends and schedules may be on several sheets; a drafting view only on one (use duplicateIfPlaced for a copy). Find items with list_views (viewType Legend, DraftingView, Schedule). dryRun defaults to true.

item.description: Legend / drafting view / schedule: id or exact name.

xMm.description: position=xy: left edge, mm from the sheet's left edge.

yMm.description: position=xy: top edge, mm from the sheet's bottom edge.

gapMm.description: Minimum gap to other items, sheet mm.

marginsMm.description: Frame margins in sheet mm. Default GOST 2.301: left 20, top 5, right 5, bottom 5.

stampWidthMm.description: Stamp width at the bottom-right, kept free. 0 = none.

stampHeightMm.description: Stamp height at the bottom-right, kept free. 0 = none.

duplicateIfPlaced.description: Drafting view already on another sheet: place a duplicate with detailing.

tools.name: rename
tools.title: Rename views and sheets
tools.description: Renames views (plans, legends, drafting views, schedules...) or sheets (name or number). Either give explicit 'items' with new values, or select elements (ids / viewType / nameContains / numberContains) and apply find/replace, prefix/suffix or a numbering pattern like 'АР-{n:00}' (sheets ordered naturally by current number). All conflicts are checked first: duplicate view names within the same view type, duplicate sheet numbers, forbidden characters; conflicting items are reported and left unchanged. Swaps (A->B, B->A) work. dryRun defaults to true: show the preview and get the user's confirmation before calling with dryRun=false. Undoable (Ctrl+Z).

items.description: Explicit renames. Each item: id or current (view name / sheet number), and newName and/or newNumber (sheets).

viewType.description: Bulk, views: FloorPlan, Legend, DraftingView, Schedule, ...

nameContains.description: Bulk: only names containing this text.

numberContains.description: Bulk, sheets: only numbers containing this text.

field.description: Bulk, sheets: change name or number.

regex.description: Treat find as a .NET regular expression ($1 in replace).

prefix.description: Bulk: add prefix (skipped if already present).

suffix.description: Bulk: add suffix (skipped if already present).

pattern.description: Bulk: numbering pattern with {n} or {n:00}, e.g. 'АР-{n:00}'.

tools.name: list_links
tools.title: List Revit links
tools.description: Lists Revit link instances of the active project: id, instance name, linked document title and whether it is loaded. Use link names in dimension_elements and tag_rooms.

tools.name: list_dimension_types
tools.title: List dimension types
tools.description: Lists linear dimension types of the active project (names for the dimensionType argument).

tools.name: dimension_grids
tools.title: Dimension grids
tools.description: Creates chain dimensions between grids on a plan: grids are grouped into parallel families; for each family a chain dimension is placed inside the grid ends (side end/start/both) and optionally an overall dimension between the extreme grids. BEFORE calling, ask the designer which links to work with (usually AR, KR, KJ) and pass them in links, or pass hostOnly=true for project grids only; without either the tool creates nothing and returns status=links_required with suggestedLinks. dryRun defaults to true. Provide view or views. The result reports timing: elapsedMs per view, setupMs and totalElapsedMs.

view.description: One plan view (id or name). Use this or views.

grids.description: Grid names; empty = all grids in the view.

side.description: At which grid ends to place dimensions (end = top/right).

offsetMm.description: Distance from the grid ends to the dimension line, sheet mm; the overall line is twice as far.

overall.description: Add an overall dimension between the extreme grids.

dimensionType.description: Linear dimension type name (list_dimension_types). Default: project default.

links.description: Links chosen by the designer (part of the name), usually AR/KR/KJ. Only these links are used; all others are ignored.

hostOnly.description: The designer confirmed working with the project only, without links.

views.description: Several plan views (ids or names) processed in one run. Only the listed views are used; ask the designer which ones. A failed view does not cancel the others.

tools.name: dimension_elements
tools.title: Dimension families to each other and to walls
tools.description: Creates dimensions on a plan to family instances (sockets, fixtures, equipment...), measured along the view x or y axis using the family centre reference plane. mode=chain: one chain through all elements (walls=ends adds the nearest wall/structure face at both ends). mode=to_walls: for each element a dimension to the nearest wall/structural column face (walls=nearest) or to both sides (walls=both). BEFORE calling with walls, ask the designer which links to work with (usually AR, KR, KJ) and pass them in links, or pass hostOnly=true; without either the tool creates nothing and returns status=links_required with suggestedLinks. Walls are searched only in the project and the chosen links. Select elements explicitly (elements with id and link name) or by categories visible in the view (categories, nameContains; linkElements to take them from the chosen links too). Families rotated off the view axes are skipped. dryRun defaults to true. Provide view or views. The result reports timing: elapsedMs per view, setupMs and totalElapsedMs.

view.description: One plan view (id or name). Use this or views.

elements.description: Explicit elements: id and, for linked elements, the link name.

categories.description: Or: categories to take from the view, OST_* or names (e.g. OST_ElectricalFixtures).

nameContains.description: Only families/types whose name contains this text.

links.description: Links chosen by the designer (part of the name), usually AR/KR/KJ. Only these links are used; all others are ignored.

axis.description: Measure horizontally (x) or vertically (y) in the view.

mode.description: Chain through elements, or each element to walls.

walls.description: chain: none (default) or ends; to_walls: nearest (default) or both.

wallCategories.description: Categories treated as walls/structure. Default: OST_Walls, OST_StructuralColumns, OST_Columns.

maxWallDistanceMm.description: Maximum search distance to a wall, model mm.

offsetMm.description: Offset of the dimension line from the elements, sheet mm.

hostOnly.description: The designer confirmed working with the project only, without links.

linkElements.description: Also take the dimensioned elements from the links in links. Default: project elements only.

views.description: Several plan views (ids or names) processed in one run. Only the listed views are used; ask the designer which ones. A failed view does not cancel the others.

tools.name: list_room_tag_types
tools.title: List room tag types
tools.description: Lists room tag types ('Family : Type') of the active project.

tools.name: tag_rooms
tools.title: Tag rooms from linked models
tools.description: Places room tags on a plan of the current project for rooms that live in linked models (and optionally in the project itself). Rooms are taken when the plan cut plane passes through the room volume (works when the plan level differs from the architectural level, e.g. above a raised floor), or explicitly by roomLevel, inside the crop region; rooms already tagged in this view are skipped. Tag at the room location point or the room box centre. dryRun defaults to true.

links.description: Links with rooms (part of the name). Empty = all loaded links.

includeHost.description: Also tag rooms of the current project.

tagType.description: Room tag type 'Family : Type' (list_room_tag_types). Default: project default.

skipTagged.description: Skip rooms already tagged in this view.

placement.description: Tag point: room location point or room box centre.

levelToleranceMm.description: Tolerance around the cut plane when checking room volumes, mm.

roomLevel.description: Level name in the link to take rooms from (when elevations differ).

tools.name: list_view_filters
tools.title: List view filters
tools.description: Lists parameter filters (Фильтры) of the project with categories and the views/templates that use them.

tools.name: list_view_templates
tools.title: List view templates
tools.description: Lists view templates: name, view type, scale, applied filters with visibility, whether the template controls filters, and how many views use it.

tools.name: list_filterable_parameters
tools.title: List filterable parameters
tools.description: Lists parameters usable in a view filter for all given categories (common parameters), with value storage type.

nameContains.description: Only parameters whose name contains this text.

tools.name: create_view_filter
tools.title: Create view filter
tools.description: Creates (or with overwriteExisting updates) a rule-based view filter for categories. Rules: parameter name, operator (text: equals, not_equals, contains, not_contains, begins_with, ends_with; numbers: equals, not_equals, greater, greater_or_equal, less, less_or_equal - values in display units, e.g. mm; any: has_value, has_no_value), value. logic and/or. Reports how many project elements match. Apply it to a view or template with set_graphics_overrides. dryRun defaults to true.

rules.description: Rules; empty = all elements of the categories.

tools.name: set_graphics_overrides
tools.title: Set graphics overrides (filter or category)
tools.description: Overrides graphics in a view or a view template (pass the template name as view) for a filter (added to the view if missing) or a category: line colour/weight/pattern, surface colour/pattern, cut line and cut pattern, transparency, halftone, visibility. Colours as #RRGGBB or 'R,G,B'; patterns by name or 'solid'. Warns when the view's template controls these settings. dryRun defaults to true.

view.description: View or view template: id or name.

reset.description: Start from empty overrides instead of the current ones.

tools.name: remove_view_filter
tools.title: Remove filter from view
tools.description: Removes a filter from a view or view template (the filter itself stays in the project). dryRun defaults to true.

tools.name: apply_view_template
tools.title: Apply view template
tools.description: Applies a view template to views (explicit names/ids, or selected by viewType/nameContains), or removes the template with template='none'. Incompatible view types are reported and skipped. dryRun defaults to true.

tools.name: create_view_template
tools.title: Create view template from view
tools.description: Creates a new view template from an existing view's settings (Создать шаблон из текущего вида). dryRun defaults to true.

tools.name: get_parameter_values
tools.title: Read parameter values
tools.description: Reads parameter values of elements: select by ids or categories (optionally only those visible in a view, or from a linked model with link), filter with where-conditions (equals, not_equals, contains, not_contains, begins_with, empty, not_empty, greater, less). For each requested parameter returns the value as shown in Revit, storage type, whether it is a type parameter and read-only. Without parameters (or with listParameterNames) returns the available instance and type parameter names per category. At most 300 elements are returned in detail; total is always reported.

categories.description: Categories, OST_* or names (e.g. OST_Doors, Листы, Сведения о проекте).

view.description: Only elements visible in this view (id or name).

link.description: Read elements from this linked model (part of the name).

types.description: Select element types (типоразмеры) instead of instances.

where.description: Conditions on parameter values (all must match).

parameters.description: Parameter names to read (instance first, then type).

tools.name: set_parameter_values
tools.title: Write parameter values
tools.description: Writes parameter values of project elements. Either the same 'values' for all selected elements (selection as in get_parameter_values: ids / categories / view / where / types), or per-element 'items' [{id, values}]. Values are text as in Revit: numbers may include units ('2400', '2,4 м'), Yes/No as 'да/нет'. Type parameters change every instance of the type and are blocked unless allowTypeParameters=true; the result lists affected types with instance counts. Read-only, formula-driven and missing parameters are reported and skipped. Linked elements cannot be changed. dryRun defaults to true: shows old -> new per element; get the user's confirmation before dryRun=false. Undoable (Ctrl+Z).

values.description: Parameter name -> value for all selected elements.

allowTypeParameters.description: Allow changing type parameters (affects all instances of the type).

maxElements.description: Safety limit on the number of elements.
